contexts.text: Spirits express more things in a minute, than... AC 2209. AC 3226. HH 240.
In the sense of the letter are expressed those things which...

In the Prophets each thing is expressed in a twofold way... One expression relates to what is celestial or good, and the other to what is spiritual or truth. AC 2212. AC 2712. AC 3901. AC 4137:end. AC 7711. NJHD 260, NJHD 265, References. DSS 81. DSS 84. AE 466:2. AE 660:2. AE 775.
The same thing is here expressed in other words.
This sounds harsher in the sense of the letter (than) when this expression passes towards Heaven... Therefore the expression is milder than it sounds in the letter.
The things which in the sense of the letter are expressed by external things...
For naked spiritual things... cannot be expressed in the words of human speech.
There are also many things in the same ideas which can never be expressed in bodily speech.
By this speech (through the Eustachian tube) they could much more fully express the feelings of the mind, and the ideas of thought...
There are series of fibres in the lips... which have been created also to express the ideas of the mind.
Arcana which... are never expressible except by means of variations and changes of the state of the light and of the heavenly flame, by means of which angelic speech and thought are carried on.
The Angels can express in one word what man cannot in a thousand.
A single expression of the Word... can induce a whole false doctrine.
Scarcely expressible by ideas like ours.
The speech of the Angels is most expressive...
Are expressed by a soft sound.
